author: Falcon9x5
what_it_is: Lumines EU Save. Puzzle Mode complete, 32 skins unlocked.
format: PSP save folder, 4 files at the zip's root, with no folder: PARAM.SFO (SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY ULES00043LUMINES, TITLE LUMINES, SAVEDATA_FILE_LIST names DATA.BIN with its hash), DATA.BIN 18464 bytes (encrypted by the system's savedata call), ICON0.PNG, PIC1.PNG

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psp-savedata.py memstick <zip> <memory stick>: writes the zip's files, unchanged, to PSP/SAVEDATA/<SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY>/ (the name read from PARAM.SFO)

ppsspp@ppsspp.detail: no Lumines (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It) image in the library (it has Lumines (USA) only)
